[LCCO.8.4] An `error` clause's body sees the matched
`CallError` bound as `error`, as an `on` body sees `response` ([LCCO.6.2]). No
other name is bound: the compiler **must** refuse a read of any other name for
it as an unknown binding. `error` is a reserved word ([LLEX.9.6]), so no binding
the author introduces can share the name.
